candidate.production_impact: The public GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits API still passes its validated since/until values to both list queries, but this changed count command no longer passes them to git rev-list. Any time-filtered request therefore returns a filtered body with the count, Link pagination, X-Total, and X-PageCount for the unfiltered history. With path set, a path that has commits only outside the requested interval can also bypass the intended zero-match check and return 200 with an empty list instead of the previous 404. This breaks the documented date-filter contract and makes clients paginate against nonexistent results.
candidate.minimal_fix: Restore adding --since and --until to CommitsCount when the respective option is non-empty, so its rev-list predicate matches the list queries. Add coverage for time-filtered counts, including the path case.
